name: Config
description: A schema for the .doctrine-project.json files of every Doctrine repository

$schema.description: URI of this schema, used by editors to validate the file

active.description: Indicates if the project is actively maintained

slug.description: A unique identifier for the project

docsSlug.description: A unique identifier for the docs

versions.description: Optional overrides for the versions discovered from the git tags and branches. Add an entry only to override a derived value.

slug.description: Unique version, usually the major and minor version (X.Y) or 'latest'. Derived from git when omitted: the highest version uses 'latest', the other versions use their name

branchName.description: Name of the branch that handles the given version. Derived from git when omitted. If no branch exists, the latest tag is used on docs build

current.description: Causes this version to be aliased as 'current' and 'stable'. Derived from git when omitted: the highest version with a stable release is current

maintained.description: Indicates if this is a maintained version. Derived from git when omitted: current and upcoming versions are maintained. Set true to keep an older version maintained during a migration period

upcoming.description: Indicates that this is an upcoming version. Derived from git when omitted: versions above current without a stable release are upcoming

lifeSupport.description: Indicates that this version is on life support, an old major that only receives security fixes. This cannot be derived from git, set it explicitly

aliases.description: Aliases for a version. The current version automatically gets 'current' and 'stable'; set this to add an extra alias
